column1: # First match wins. Regexes are awk EREs, matched case-insensitively.
# A title regex of * matches anything. Unmatched windows count as "other".
# Before these rules run, a browser tab whose title contains one of your
# recent project names (seen in VS Code or WezTerm) counts as work on
# that project, e.g. your own app running on localhost.
